content.en_US:
3x3x7. Cools a hot fluid with a coolant, no power needed. The port blocks still accept cables but draw nothing.

Two ID slots: slot 0 is the coolant, slot 1 is the fluid being cooled. Both only accept pairs from the built-in pairing table. An invalid ID does nothing and gives no message - the tank type just stays put.

Sneak-right-click with an ID sets the COOLANT only; the other one needs the GUI.

Coolant use is not 1:1 - it scales by the heat ratio of the two fluids. Throughput caps at 16,000 mB/tick, and both sides need at least 1 mB to start.

See also:
[[Large Catalytic Chemical Factory|Large Catalytic Chemical Factory]]
[[Large Centrifuge|Large Centrifuge]]
content.zh_CN:
用冷却剂给热流体降温, 不耗电。

两个识别码槽: 0 号是冷却剂, 1 号是被冷却的流体。两槽都只认内置配对表里的流体。插错识别码不会有任何反应也不提示, 罐型保持原样。

冷却剂消耗不是 1:1, 按两种流体的热量比配平。单 tick 上限 16,000 mB, 两侧都至少要有 1 mB 才启动。

另见:
[[大型催化化工厂|Large Catalytic Chemical Factory]]
[[大型离心机|Large Centrifuge]]
